history.summary: Most likely referent for this CSV row is the Shri Danteshwari Temple at Danteshwari Para, Ward No. 2, Dongargarh (Rajnandgaon district, pin 491445) — a small local Devi shrine listed on JustDial, Yappe and top-rated.online (4.0, 25 reviews). It is NOT the famous 14th-century Danteshwari Shakti Peetha at Dantewada, South Bastar (~300 km away). CSV town 'Rajnandgaon' is approximate: this shrine is in Dongargarh town. AMBIGUITY: Ambagarh Chowki (also Rajnandgaon district) has a separately listed 'Danteshwari Mandir' (indiainfo.net); the CSV row could intend either. No documented history, founding date, or festival details for the Dongargarh shrine beyond its listings; Navratri is listed as the customary observance only.

name: Shri Danteshwari Temple, Dongargarh
town_description: Dongargarh is a town in Rajnandgaon district, Chhattisgarh, best known as a pilgrimage centre for the Maa Bamleshwari Temple atop a hill, reached by steps and ropeway.

travel.airport: Swami Vivekananda Airport, Raipur (nearest major airport)
travel.road: On NH 53 corridor; connected by road to Rajnandgaon and Raipur
